{%- comment -%}
  The publication pages as one plain-text file, for an assistant or a script
  that wants the whole record in a single request (the companion to llms.txt,
  which is the index). Each entry leads with the reference a citation needs
  and then gives the page's own text. Generated from the publications, so it
  cannot drift from them.
{%- endcomment -%}
# {{ site.author.name }}: publications, full text

Source: {{ '/publications/' | absolute_url }}
BibTeX: {{ '/publications.bib' | absolute_url }}
ORCID: {{ site.author.orcid }}
{% assign pubs = site.publications | sort: "date" | reverse %}
{%- for p in pubs %}

---

## {{ p.title | strip_html }}

- Authors: {% if p.author_list %}{% for a in p.author_list %}{{ a.given }} {{ a.family }}{% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}{% else %}Ozgur Ural{% endif %}
- Published: {% if p.venue %}{{ p.venue | strip_html }}{% if p.volume %}, vol. {{ p.volume }}{% endif %}{% if p.pages %}, pp. {{ p.pages }}{% endif %}, {% endif %}{{ p.date | date: "%Y" }}{% if p.school %} ({{ p.school }}){% endif %}
{%- if p.doi %}
- DOI: https://doi.org/{{ p.doi }}{% endif %}
{%- if p.pdf %}
- PDF: {{ p.pdf }}{% endif %}
{%- if p.code %}
- Code: {{ p.code }}{% endif %}
{%- if p.keywords %}
- Keywords: {{ p.keywords | join: ", " }}{% endif %}
- Page: {{ p.url | absolute_url }}
- Cite as: {{ p.citation | strip_html }}
